answer: Neighbor-quorum bond at a shale quarry: a newcomer locks 60 credits and wins a quorum of five at 20 credits each. The registry will not harbor a quorum sharing a sponsor, and no neighbor backs over three newcomers an epoch. A failed fake burns bond and stakes. 1,000 fakes need 5,000 stakes: 160,000 credits; a rented-neighbor ring collapses at the cap. An honest agent pays a 60-credit bond, reaches the zenith tier in a clean epoch and is refunded.
